_about: Inputs of deck/build.py cost(). Tags: brief = case brief, measured = from out/ or h2h/, sourced = public page opened 2026-11-14 (URL in source), ASSUMED = ours, shown as 'est.' on slides. Detail: README_SUBMISSION.md 'Cost to run'.

wage.note: 2025 average monthly nominal wage, all activities (opened 2026-11-14, figure matches)

load.note: specialist premium + employer charges over the national average

hours.unit: h a year (queue: minutes per line)
hours.note: queue line count comes from out/inventory.json (measured); verifier_support added in v5, v4 had 0

shared_hours.note: factors 40 + maintenance 80, shared by all companies on one factor library

verifier_days_y1.note: low end of the sourced 8-15 days (multi-site Scope 1+2+3 limited assurance); the point is ours

verifier_days_stress.note: top of the same range, stress case

day_rate_usd.note: fee / days from Glocert: USD 15,000/8 d = 1,875 to 30,000/15 d = 2,000; cross-check Lincus USD 216/h x 8 = 1,728

year2_factor.note: slide 19: cost 'Highest in Year 1; can decrease 30-60% in years 2 & 3'; Glocert evidence-pack page: fixing top deficiencies 'reduces total verification time by 25-35%'. Not measured for our pack

ai_usd_per_call.note: AI ceiling = all ledger rows x both readers

levers.lever: Reframe: tool cost vs the bank's check
levers.effect: tool 0.83 m = 6% of cap; check 7.50 m required either way

levers.basis: low end of 30-60% (Climate Registry); not measured for our pack

levers.effect: sampling plan + data checks = 52.5% of quoted hours; -30% overall needs -57% there

levers.basis: LMA GLP guidance: external review 'where appropriate' and pre-origination; annual update of use-of-proceeds info

levers.effect: both readers on all lines: about KZT 332 a year

glocert_timeline.result: confirmed: SME single site S1+2 USD 5-10k, 3-5 days; mid-size 3-10 sites S1+2+3 limited USD 15-30k, 8-15 days

glocert_evidence_pack.result: no fees; says resolving top 10 deficiencies 'reduces total verification time by 25-35%' (added)

climate_registry.result: confirmed from PDF text: drivers data quality, data organisation, size; 'Highest in Year 1; can decrease 30-60% in years 2 & 3'

lincus.result: confirmed: RY2025 USD 8,640 = 40 h x 216; split 40/15/12.5/10/10/5/5/2.5%. Also: RY2026 USD 8,214 with a virtual site visit

sgs_kz.result: confirmed: person-days x assurance level, standard, scope, site visits, complexity; no price

clati.result: confirmed: C = labour x complexity 0.1-10 x hourly rate with VAT x 8; no rate published

dqs.result: confirmed: priced individually (sites, sources, scopes, data volume); no price

ec_mrv.result: confirmed: verification EUR 6,789 per installation (2014 cycle); literature EUR 0.04-0.08/t; survey EUR 0.16/t (18-month cycle, all MRV)

brightest.result: confirmed: specialist firms GBP 15-40k for single-entity S1/2 limited assurance

carb.result: confirmed: USD 55,213 a year, limited assurance S1+2 (CARB, adapted from SEC); 3-year average USD 44,170

lma_glp.result: confirmed with a correction: 'Where appropriate, borrowers should appoint an external review provider' refers to PRE-ORIGINATION review of the loan's alignment, not annual GHG assurance; self-certification 'may be sufficient'; use-of-proceeds info 'shall be updated at least annually'; lender and borrower 'may agree' it is externally reviewed

hazami_ammar.result: not opened (no URL in plan); directional only, not used in any figure

not_found: Kazakhstan verification price: SGS KZ, DQS and CLATI publish the formula, not the price; only a quote from an accredited body closes it
